verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this subject is one community comment. It says Chroma Cloud offers sharding via collections and cold/warm object-storage tiers for 'scale to zero' multi-tenant use cases, which loosely supports cheap per-tenant collections. No first-party docs describe tenant, namespace or partition isolation. The BYOC single-tenant option and fork pricing are separate features. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of tenant/namespace/per-tenant collection isolation, documented limits (collections per tenant, quotas), cost model for many small tenants, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can isolate many tenants cheaply using namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections with documented limits

citations.quote: sharding via collections, distributed scaling, and object storage on S3 with cold/warm tiers for 'scale to zero' multi-tenant use cases
